REVIEW T-F17 (mission-control UX): branch task/T-F17-mission-control pushed, gate PASS.

Deliverables committed:
- contracts/agent_events.md: aicad.agent_events/1 schema (8 dag.* event types)
- services/dag/event_journal.py: EventJournal — wraps emit(), persists to events.jsonl; 6/6 tests pass
- services/dag/executor.py: EventJournal wired into run() and resume()
- ui/abstract/mission_control_view.h: MissionControlView model (run tree, event stream, steer state)
- host/src/ui/mission_control_panel.{h,cpp}: ImGui panel — run tree / event trail / steering controls; loadReplay() from events.jsonl
- host/src/ui/scenarios.{h,cpp}: AI_CAD_SHOT=mission_control static capture (36 capstone events, 2 runs, 13 nodes)
- host/src/app.cpp: panel wired, vsync disabled in shot mode (glfwSwapInterval(0) — fixes headless hang)
- Screenshot: scratch/mission_control_shots/mission_control_01_capstone.png (197KB, 1340x838)

Partial DoD note: event schema + journal + panel + scenario screenshot are solid. Worker RPC seam (dag_pause/dag_approve/dag_inject/dag_set_autonomy) is stubbed in the panel — live steering not yet wired. Design-brief flow not implemented. These depend on T-A3/T-F3.
